description.value: Tiki Village Inn is a Polynesian-themed motel and suite property in Vernon, BC, offering standard rooms, executive suites, and kitchenette units arranged around an inner courtyard with a heated pool. The property caters to short visits and extended stays alike, with free parking, on-site laundry, BBQ and picnic facilities, and a fenced dog park. Its location near major Okanagan thoroughfares and within walking distance of Vernon Jubilee Hospital makes it a practical overnight base for touring cyclists passing through the valley.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and provides detailed amenity information. The site consistently identifies the property as 'Tiki Village Inn' (and 'Tiki Village Inn & Suites' in the copyright footer), whereas OSM names it 'Tiki Village Motel' — a discrepancy flagged in concerns. No mention of bike storage, bike procedures, e-bike charging, or any cycling-specific amenities anywhere on the site; Free Wi-Fi and on-site guest laundry are explicitly listed on the amenities page. Phone and address are taken from the website since OSM carries neither field.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records 'Tiki Village Motel' but the website consistently uses 'Tiki Village Inn' and the copyright footer reads 'Tiki Village Inn & Suites' — OSM tag may be outdated or incorrect.
OSM record carries no address, phone, or email — all contact details sourced from website only, so contact_confirmed fields for phone and address cannot be cross-checked against OSM.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible accommodation in Vernon, BC with an active website and booking system. Useful overnight stop for touring cyclists in the Okanagan.

Laundry.detail: On-site Guest Laundry Facilities listed explicitly in hotel amenities page

Wi-Fi.detail: Complimentary Wi-Fi listed as a hotel amenity; website states 'high speed wireless connection free of charge from anywhere on our facilities.'

wow_evidence: heated pool... on-site laundry, BBQ and picnic facilities
